annotation.bound_parties_text: The test method is intended for use by A-UGV manufacturers, installers, and users to confirm positioning or docking performance.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This test method is intended for use by A-UGV manufacturers, installers, and users to quantitatively confirm the maneuverability and repeatability of an A-UGV’s positioning or docking.
